final: SELECT f.orderslink AS fee_order_reference, o.ordertune AS order_type, AVG(f.rebtotal) AS avg_rebate_usd, AVG((f.rebrate - f.feerate) / f.feerate) AS avg_rate_expression, AVG(f.rebtotal) - (SELECT AVG(group_avg_rebate) FROM (SELECT AVG(f2.rebtotal) AS group_avg_rebate FROM fees AS f2 JOIN orders AS o2 ON f2.orderslink = o2.recordvault COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY f2.orderslink, o2.ordertune)) AS avg_rebate_minus_group_average FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.ordertune HAVING AVG(f.rebtotal) > (SELECT AVG(group_avg_rebate) FROM (SELECT AVG(f2.rebtotal) AS group_avg_rebate FROM fees AS f2 JOIN orders AS o2 ON f2.orderslink = o2.recordvault COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY f2.orderslink, o2.ordertune)) ORDER BY avg_rebate_minus_group_average DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
